description: Add a flag to a user of this app by hand, as the anti-cheat does when it catches something (users.flags, the count neblla_list_users shows), or take one back with delta -1 (never below 0). A flag is a mark for the developer to look at: it never bans, mutes or warns the user, and the user is not told. An added flag reaches the developer's `flag` webhook with by: "developer". Returns the user's flags now.

delta.description: 1 (default) adds a flag; -1 takes one back

reason.description: Why, for the moderation log and the webhook

name: neblla_flag_user
title: Flag user
